serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: …
You: I think you should talk with Shanice about it. She feels bad for some reason and it’s not something you should know from me.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
I-is he angry? I can’t tell, he almost always looks the same…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Perhaps you are right. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I kinda figured out why she feels bad anyway, but I… {{wi}}didn’t want to confront her about it…{{wi}} I was afraid she would interpret my concern in a bad way.
You: You knew about all this stuff?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I don’t know exactly what she told you, but I suspect she noticed that she did something really troubling. She’s rather smart after all.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Next time you come over, we three should have a long talk.
You: Sure…
You: I gotta get going now, bye!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: See you later.
